The Buffet or Sideboard Storage in the Dining Room. Hold the things that only come out when the table is being set.

What done looks like:
1. Two tablecloths rolled with their matching napkins inside them in one drawer
2. Serving bowls nested by size in the next
3. The large platters standing on edge behind a divider
4. Taper candles of one length in a latched drawer
